Test Case: Verify pilot XPay API credentials are configured via environment variables (API key + signing_key)
Expected Result: Credentials load correctly; no secrets exposed in client-side code or logs

Test Case: Verify webhook endpoint URL is registered in XPay Settings Page
Expected Result: Webhook URL matches Mentora pilot callback route

Test Case: Verify signing_key from XPay Settings matches server-side secret used for verification
Expected Result: Keys match byte-for-byte; mismatch causes verification failure in test harness

Test Case: Verify legacy XPay integration code paths are removed or feature-flagged off after migration
Expected Result: No deprecated endpoints called during checkout/payment flow

Test Case: Create payment session using new XPay API for a single paid course checkout
Expected Result: API returns success with payment reference/transaction ID; user redirected to XPay checkout or embedded flow opens

Test Case: Create payment session with correct amount currency and order metadata (course ID user ID)
Expected Result: Request payload matches cart total; metadata stored for reconciliation

Test Case: Create payment session for mixed cart (multiple courses)
Expected Result: Single payment created for combined total; all line items linked to transaction

Test Case: Create payment session with valid voucher/discount applied
Expected Result: Discounted amount sent to XPay; original and final amounts auditable

Test Case: Reject payment creation when cart is empty
Expected Result: API returns validation error; no XPay session created

Test Case: Reject payment creation when course price was tampered client-side
Expected Result: Server recalculates price; payment created with server-side amount only (regression: TC-NEW-002)

Test Case: Prevent duplicate payment when pending payment already exists for same user/cart
Expected Result: Second payment blocked; user sees pending payment message (regression: TC-NEW-001 / TC-NEW-004)

Test Case: Handle XPay API timeout during payment creation
Expected Result: User sees friendly error; payment record remains pending or not created; retry allowed

Test Case: Handle XPay API 4xx/5xx during payment creation
Expected Result: Error logged; no false success state; user can retry checkout

Test Case: Successful payment callback updates transaction status to PAID/COMPLETED
Expected Result: Payment record status updated; enrollment granted

Test Case: Failed/declined payment callback updates status to FAILED
Expected Result: Payment marked failed; user not enrolled; cart remains or can retry

Test Case: Pending payment remains PENDING until final webhook or status poll
Expected Result: No premature enrollment; UI shows pending state

Test Case: Student with pending payment is not shown in instructor enrolled roster
Expected Result: Pending-only students excluded (regression: MEN-1257)

Test Case: Payment status query via new XPay API returns consistent state with internal DB
Expected Result: External status matches internal payment record

Test Case: User redirected to success page only after verified successful payment
Expected Result: Success page not shown on pending/failed transactions

Test Case: User redirected to failure/cancel page on declined or abandoned payment
Expected Result: Failure page shown; user can return to checkout

Test Case: Accept webhook with valid HMAC-SHA512 signature in xpay-signature header
Expected Result: HTTP 200 returned; payment status processed

Test Case: Verify signature computed from raw request body bytes (not re-serialized JSON)
Expected Result: Valid signature passes; whitespace/key-order changes fail if body altered

Test Case: Reject webhook with missing xpay-signature header
Expected Result: HTTP 401/403 returned; payment status not updated

Test Case: Reject webhook with invalid/tampered xpay-signature header
Expected Result: HTTP 401/403 returned; event ignored; security log recorded

Test Case: Reject webhook signed with wrong signing_key
Expected Result: HTTP 401/403 returned; no side effects on payment/enrollment

Test Case: Reject webhook with valid signature but modified payload body
Expected Result: HTTP 401/403 returned; tampered data not persisted

Test Case: Accept webhook with valid ECDSA signature in xpay-private-signature header (if integration uses ECDSA)
Expected Result: HTTP 200 returned; payment status processed

Test Case: Reject webhook with invalid xpay-private-signature header
Expected Result: HTTP 401/403 returned; event ignored

Test Case: Ensure signing_key/secret is never logged or returned in API responses
Expected Result: Logs and responses contain no secret values

Test Case: Ensure webhook endpoint requires POST and rejects GET/PUT/DELETE probes
Expected Result: Unsupported methods return 405/404; no state change

Test Case: Replay attack — resend old valid webhook with same eventId
Expected Result: Duplicate ignored idempotently; no double enrollment or double charge

Test Case: Webhook from non-XPay IP/user-agent without valid signature is rejected
Expected Result: HTTP 401/403; no processing

Test Case: Process same webhook event twice (XPay retry simulation)
Expected Result: Second delivery handled idempotently; single enrollment/charge

Test Case: Concurrent duplicate webhooks for same transaction processed safely
Expected Result: Only one state transition applied; no race-condition duplicate enrollments

Test Case: Return HTTP 200 within 2-second timeout — XPay does not retry unnecessarily
Expected Result: Single processing; no duplicate side effects

Test Case: Return HTTP 500 — XPay retries with exponential backoff
Expected Result: Eventually succeeds when server recovers; still idempotent

Test Case: Return HTTP 401 for invalid signature — XPay does not mark transaction as processed on Mentora side
Expected Result: Payment remains unchanged; invalid callbacks never update DB

Test Case: Student completes full checkout flow end-to-end in pilot (course → cart → pay → success)
Expected Result: Course access granted; receipt/confirmation visible

Test Case: Checkout with expired voucher shows validation error and blocks payment (TC-NEW-005)
Expected Result: Expired voucher rejected; no XPay session for invalid discount

Test Case: Double-click pay button does not create duplicate payments (TC-NEW-003)
Expected Result: Only one payment request processed

Test Case: Free course checkout bypasses XPay and enrolls directly
Expected Result: No XPay call; enrollment immediate

Test Case: Checkout page displays correct total before redirect to XPay
Expected Result: Displayed amount matches server-calculated amount sent to XPay

Test Case: Successful XPay payment appears in admin payments panel with correct amount
Expected Result: Payment record visible with matching transaction reference

Test Case: Failed XPay payment appears with failed status in admin/reporting
Expected Result: Failed transaction auditable; no false paid status

Test Case: Webhook processing errors are logged with eventId and transaction reference
Expected Result: Ops can trace failed webhook handling

Test Case: Full smoke test suite passes against pilot XPay credentials
Expected Result: All critical XPAY-* cases pass in pilot

Test Case: Test transaction in pilot sandbox completes and webhook received on pilot callback URL
Expected Result: End-to-end pilot flow verified

Test Case: Pilot signing_key rotation test — update key in env and XPay settings
Expected Result: Webhooks verify with new key; old key rejected

Test Case: Production credentials and webhook URL documented and stored securely (not in repo)
Expected Result: Runbook available for ops; secrets in vault/env only

Test Case: Feature flag/toggle allows switching from legacy to new XPay integration
Expected Result: Toggle enables new API without downtime

Test Case: Rollback plan verified — revert to legacy integration if pilot issues found
Expected Result: Rollback tested; no data corruption

Test Case: Monitoring/alerting configured for webhook verification failures
Expected Result: Alert fires on spike of 401 signature failures

Test Case: Monitoring/alerting configured for payment creation failures and status mismatches
Expected Result: Alert fires on XPay API errors or stuck pending payments

Test Case: Send webhook with empty body and no signature
Expected Result: HTTP 401/400 returned; no DB update

Test Case: Send webhook with malformed JSON payload and valid-looking signature
Expected Result: HTTP 400 returned; no partial DB update

Test Case: Send webhook for unknown/non-existent transaction ID
Expected Result: HTTP 404 or ignored safely; logged for investigation

Test Case: Send webhook with SUCCESS status for already-completed payment
Expected Result: Idempotent no-op; no duplicate enrollment

Test Case: Attempt payment creation with invalid/missing XPay API credentials
Expected Result: Clear error; no orphan payment records

Test Case: Attempt checkout while logged out
Expected Result: Redirect to login; no payment created

Test Case: Checkout and payment error messages render correctly in EN locale
Expected Result: English messages shown for payment failures/pending states

Test Case: Checkout and payment error messages render correctly in AR locale
Expected Result: Arabic messages shown for payment failures/pending states
